sloka: इन्द्रलोकम् गतो राजा स्व अर्जितेन एव कर्मणा ।रज्ये भगीरथम् पुत्रम् अभिषिच्य नरर्षभः ॥१-४२-१०॥
transliteration: indralokam gato rājā sva arjitena eva karmaṇā ।rajye bhagīratham putram abhiṣicya nararṣabhaḥ ॥1-42-10॥

translations.english: The king (Dilipa) performed the coronation of his son Bhagiratha and reached the region of Indra as a reward for virtuous acts done by him.
translations.hindi: सगर, हे राम ! कुपित हो, उनसे बोले--जाओ और पुनः प्रथ्वी खोदो
